Name: Carrot SummerCrop
Author: Kjay9558
Description:
This mod adds Carrots as plantable crops during summer.

The seeds can be bought from Pierre.
Carrots take 4 days to grow.

Gus now sells the recipe for Carrot Stew.

The carrots work with the seed maker and better quality crops give more seeds.

Requirements:
[list]
[*]JsonAssets
[*]SpaceCore
[*]Expanded Preconditions Utility
[*]PFM - Proucer Framework Mod

[/list]
This is my first mod, feedback is much appreciated.
The source code can be found here:  [url=https://github.com/Kjay9558/-JA-CropCarrotSV]GitHub
[/url]
